basic_info.description: This beautifully remodeled top floor flat is nestled in a boutique three-unit building. Located just one block from the renowned Hayes Valley shops, restaurants and the new Trader Joes, this home places you at the heart of one of San Francisco's most desirable neighborhoods. This urban retreat has a spacious deck with Bison IPE tiles that receives abundant sunlight and offers captivating views of the surrounding neighborhood, including the iconic gold-accented roof of City Hall. The open-concept floorplan highlights beautiful wood flooring, built-in speakers and new lighting fixtures creating a welcoming atmosphere ideal for hosting guests. The remodeled kitchen features a large island, sleek quartz counters, wine fridge and a striking glass tile backsplash. The inviting living room offers a wood burning fireplace for cozy evenings while the dining room has lovely city views. Both bathrooms have been remodeled with quartz counters and Fire Clay Tile. Lighting throughout the residence has been exclusively upgraded with fixtures from Herman Miller, Rejuvenation and Schoolhouse Electric. The Building  improvements consist of a newer roof, windows, exterior paint and siding. Laundry, storage,& deck irrigation included.
